0022600085.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Atlanta Hawks visit the Orlando Magic. Atlanta will be without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery) and Noah Penda (hamstring), and Anthony Black, Franz Wagner, Jase Richardson and Jonathan Isaac are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The Hawks won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, and their most recent meeting was a 130-101 win in Orlando on April 1, 2026.
